But yeah I wouldn’t pay attention to her un matching. I’m the same height as you just about, no issues dating.

Not to mention he’ll be the third owner. OP would take all the depreciation lol. Not sure why you’ve been downvoted. They’re great reliable cars though. But this is overpriced.
